input_equivalence.basis: Four reviewed public runtime source files and one new speech/settings regression file change. All dependency inputs, workflows, licences, notices, model assets, vendor provenance and six prior resolved inventories remain byte-identical to the actual merged PR26 base. No new dependency resolution, advisory scan or installed qualification was performed.

qualification.scope: Focused synthetic settings-to-speech gain, quiet-hours and acknowledged settings persistence repair, including bounded save/reset/import paths. No complete public/composed aggregate, real Postgres, model inference, packaged startup, physical playback/device, Windows installer, installed-app or live qualification.
qualification.source_integrity: Exactly five reviewed public source paths and canonical manifest/binding change. All 2498 source files are inventoried, including the new speech/settings regression. Dependencies, workflows, licences, notices, model assets, vendor provenance and all six retained SBOMs remain unchanged.
qualification.behavior: Use current saved volume and quiet-hours policy at speech execution; preserve explicit overrides and mute; carry isolated request context to fallback worker; cache unity PCM and apply current gain at playback. Publish managed immediate global/per-user snapshots only after accepted persistence. Fallback success requires all requested non-secret values in the JSON snapshot selected by the existing loader; full replacement paths also prove removed non-secret keys are absent. Stage reset/import privately and keep authenticated imports scoped to the active user. Persist and publish the same retained import blob even if a slow DB save exceeds cache TTL.
qualification.checks: On the actual merged PR26 source tree plus the reviewed successor: 65 shipped speech/settings methods, 17 existing speech methods, 11 prior independent controls and 21 renewed independent settings controls pass (114 methods total), plus two API reset probes and 18 tool-schema tests. Ruff, Black, atomic-JSON and sync-bridge gates pass. Six independent mutation negatives include the expired staging-cache fault. Synthetic provider/model/audio boundaries and no model calls.
qualification.tool_schema_retention: Prior description compaction remains byte-identical. 76 tools serialize to 61977 UTF-8 tools-array bytes under the unchanged strict <62000 cap; 23 bytes of margin. This is neither an HTTP-envelope limit nor a model-token budget.
qualification.persistence_limit: No cross-store transaction or rollback guarantee. Credentials can persist independently when a mixed request returns False; ordinary mixed user/global updates can commit the user store before a global failure. Direct externally mutable manager.settings writes remain outside managed copy-on-write paths. Explicit staging with save_immediately=False retains its existing semantics. Existing loader selection is unchanged.
qualification.integration_limit: Private adoption must consume the resulting public pin and map the new regression through the canonical ownership list. Do not copy public runtime corrections into private shadows.
